notes:
Composed of {覇|は} (hegemony/supremacy) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Used for someone who dominates or conquers, whether in historical, sports, or business contexts. Carries a strong, dramatic tone suggesting absolute dominance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{覇者|はしゃ}: industry leader/dominant player
- ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{覇者|はしゃ}: tournament champion
- {覇者|はしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{君臨|くんりん}→君臨：11957_kunrin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reign as ruler
- {覇者|はしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim for the top

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{王者|おうじゃ}→王者：13539_ouja⟧: king, champion — emphasizes supreme position, often used in sports
- ⟦チャンピオン→チャンピオン：19399_chanpion⟧: champion — loanword, most common in modern sports contexts
- {征服者|せいふくしゃ}: conqueror — specifically military conquest
- ⟦{勝者|しょうしゃ}→勝者：15630_shousha⟧: winner — neutral, simply the person who won
